headers.comment: Cross-origin isolation ONLY for the standalone video-converter page, so multithreaded ffmpeg.wasm (SharedArrayBuffer) works. Scoped to this path so COOP/COEP never touch the main app (Stripe, embeds, cross-origin images).
The ffmpeg engine files have stable names and are large (~32MB wasm). Cache them immutably so a rare conversion loads instantly on repeat and works offline, overriding the global max-age=0.
